item.title: UC San Diego School of Medicine Commencement - despite being notified no flags would be permitted, Morgan Chalmiers chose to make the ceremony about political activism rather than the achievement. Morgan is reportedly headed to a pediatric residency program at the University of Minnesota. Patients deserve physicians who demonstrate professionalism, sound judgment, and respect for institutional rules. If this is how she conducts herself at one of the most important milestones of her medical career, it's fair to ask whether that standard is being met.
